scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build -w functions
scripts.test: npm run build -w functions && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/session.test.mjs tests/questions.test.mjs tests/answers.test.mjs tests/broadcast.test.mjs tests/broadcast-render.test.mjs tests/code-draft.test.mjs tests/code-editor.test.mjs tests/reporting.test.mjs tests/student-questions.test.mjs tests/pilot-fixtures.test.mjs
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-inlectra --only auth,database,functions
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-inlectra --only auth,database,functions "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs tests/callable.test.mjs"
scripts.test:load: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-inlectra --only auth,database,functions "node --test tests/load.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e:server: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-inlectra --only auth,database,functions "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:load && npm run test:e2e
